context: A police officer briefs a corporate IT team
purpose: Teach: 本田/石田/安田/川口/神田/大塚/野口/高木

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社IT統括の本田部長、ご挨拶ありがとうございました。
lines.en: Director Honda — thank you for welcoming us.
lines.style: Formal, measured opening. Slight nod in the voice. Professional warmth — acknowledging courtesy without overstating it. Steady pace, respectful eye-level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。石田さん、安田さん、川口さんが、現場担当です。
lines.en: We appreciate that. Ishida, Yasuda, and Kawaguchi are our field coordinators.
lines.style: Clear and straightforward. Efficient — no wasted words. Light warmth underneath the professionalism. A small collaborative lean, not defensive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 神田さん、大塚さん、データ管理、密に連絡を。
lines.en: Kanda and Otsuka — we'll need close communication on data management.
lines.style: Businesslike and direct. Slight emphasis on 「close」— this matters. Clipped pace. No ambiguity. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 野口さん、高木さんも、合同訓練に参加します。
lines.en: Noguchi and Takagi are joining the joint drills as well.
lines.style: Informative, steady delivery. Adding detail without fanfare. Matter-of-fact tone. Pace maintains the procedural momentum from the previous line.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.en: Thank you. We look forward to working with you.
lines.style: Respectful close. Slight bow in the voice — formal but genuine. Quiet confidence. Not rushed. Allows space for the exchange to settle.
